selectionProtocol.rule: Select the balanced candidate on 2021-2022 only, freeze it, then evaluate 2023/2024/2025. Each walk-forward fold reselects using only seasons before its validation year.
selectionProtocol.nearTieRule: Within 0.00005 balanced-score units, prefer lower RP+talent magnitude, HFA nearest 3.0, then sigma nearest 15.5.

prospectiveParallelV2.rule: Only after the held-out B gate passed, refit the unchanged deterministic search on all pre-2026 seasons for prospective 2026 shadow collection. These in-sample refit metrics are not validation evidence.
